scheme_name: Backward Classes Foreign Study Scholarship Scheme
other_conditions: Must have secured first class or at least 60% marks (or equivalent grade) in the previous examination.
Must be applying for a research degree (Ph.D.) or have at least two years of relevant experience after completing a research degree.
Must be under 35 years of age on 1st January of the application year (subject to special relaxation of up to 10 years as decided by the committee).
Family's annual income must not exceed the income limit prescribed for the creamy layer.
Eligibility category noted in source: Backward Classes
benefits_summary: Provides financial assistance to backward class students for overseas postgraduate and research programs.
documents_required: Copies of all mandatory documents (self‑attested if required)
